newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks lose 3.34 pct on selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks lose 3.34 pct on selling pressure.

text.p: Dhaka shares closed more than three percent down on Monday as many big players kept to the sidelines following the market regulator's move to probe alleged manipulation in share trading, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index fell 82.28 points or 3.34 percent at 2,375.37 on a turnover of 35.7 million taka. Of 79 traded issues, 73 lost and six gained.
Monno Ceramics lost 74.30 taka to 1,411.77 and Square Pharma fell 76 to 1,487.
